scientific_question: Does the independently reproduced ARC-v5 trainability repair generalize to the frozen ARC-Challenge validation split under supervised CE training without returning to input-insensitive one-class collapse?
dataset_task: AI2 ARC-Challenge; checksum-pinned train and validation only; exactly four-choice eligible rows; multiple-choice validation accuracy
proposed_method: repaired v5 CE condition defined by the frozen protocol
limitations: separate CPU GitHub Actions attempts show ~1e-6 to 1e-7 drift in some floating-point submetrics despite identical final loss/accuracy
PyTorch checkpoint serialization is not byte-identical across separate CI attempts

reproducibility_bug.description: train_single.py initialized LAMJEPA before applying the requested seed

claim_boundary: The seed-order repair is a software reproducibility repair only and does not change the frozen ARC-v5 scientific verdict. Same-seed semantic reproducibility is verified within runner attempts; byte-for-byte checkpoint identity across independent runners is not claimed.
